Stryker 10 CLI, transcribed from the Stryker documentation (NOT captured: no network install here).

  stryker run [configFile] [options]

  --mutate <patterns>        comma-separated globs; a glob may carry a line range:
                               src/big.js:40-45            lines 40 to 45
                               src/big.js:40:3-45:10       with columns
                               !src/**/*.test.js           negation
  --reporters <names>        comma-separated: json, clear-text, progress, html ...
  --concurrency <n>
  --timeoutMS <ms>
  --testRunner <name>        command | mocha | jest | vitest | tap | karma | jasmine | cucumber
  --commandRunner.command <cmd>   (also reachable as commandRunner.command in the config file)

Per-runner test selection (config file only; there is no CLI test-file flag):
  command  : commandRunner.command   the full command, test files appended by the caller
  mocha    : mochaOptions.spec       array of spec files
  jest     : jest.config.testMatch   array of globs
  tap      : tap.testFiles           array of files
  vitest   : none (the runner has no test-file option in Stryker)

Log markers (stdout, in order):
  Starting initial test run (<runner> test runner with "<coverage>" coverage analysis). This may take a while.
  Initial test run succeeded. Ran <n> tests in <time>.
  Mutation testing  <pct>% (elapsed: <t>, remaining: <t>) <tested>/<total> Mutants tested (<n> survived, <n> timed out)

Report: reports/mutation/mutation.json (mutation-testing-elements schema), written by the `json` reporter.
